snippet.title: The Ballad of a True Thug - Official Release Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Step into the criminal underworld of 1990s Europe. Every shot defines your fate. Every slide changes the rhythm. You don’t talk. You act.

▶️ PLAY NOW ON STEAM
🎮 TRY THE DEMO ON ITCH
🐦 FOLLOW US ON X/TWITTER

🔥 KEY FEATURES
• PRECISION COMBAT → Chain kills, earn slow-mo, control the flow
• ROCK-N-ROLL VIBES → Gritty noir aesthetic meets relentless momentum
• DARK CRIME DRAMA → A silent thief’s journey from petty crook to legend
• RISK & REWARD → Tactical buffs, stylish movement, split-second decisions

ABOUT THE GAME
Developed by a 3-person indie team over 4 years, The Ballad of a True Thug is a precision-focused top-down shooter inspired by classics like Hotline Miami and Katana Zero. Master reflexes, exploit the environment, and leave your mark on the streets of Europe.

Release Date: May 28, 2024
Platforms: PC (Steam)
Engine: Unity
Languages: EN, ES, FR, DE, RU

Drop a comment with your highest combo or favorite moment. We read everything.
Thank you for playing. This was our dream. Now it’s yours.
